_note: DRAFT prompts (14 Oct 2026) for scripts/catalog/generate_story_walls.py. Style chosen by John after tests A-J (review/tests/sw-*.json): pure, dense black line art in his own prompt's rules (no shading, edge to edge, clean even ink, our own funny tall animals, about 30% fewer curves), then about 15% of the objects hand-painted in gouache and crayon as a colour guide (pink cheeks kept). One design per series: the 5-7 sheet is the picture cropped to 100 x 70 cm + bleed; the 3-5 sheet is the same design with every shape 20% bigger. Never send John's reference pictures to the model and never copy their characters (other artists' work). Photos: two realistic mockups per product (on the floor, colouring together, from above; finished and framed on a wall); hands only, no faces.
sheet_note: 100 x 70 cm plus 3 mm bleed on every side, the same as the current print files in art/print/story-walls.
style: Fur and feathers are shown with a few short, parallel line strokes; bodies are mostly open white areas.
palette: a warm painterly palette: pumpkin orange, mustard yellow, tomato red, soft black, cornflower blue, dusty rose, sage green and cream
line_template: A pure, clean, complex black-and-white line art illustration designed as a colouring poster for large-format 100 x 70 cm paper (landscape), for several people to colour together on the floor. Subject: {subject}. Characters: whimsical, funny animals drawn tall and narrow with long upright bodies, like a crowd of standing figures; tall pointed or round ears; very big round eyes with small dot pupils looking in different directions; small triangle noses; wide wobbly W-shaped smiles; long straight whiskers; round cheek circles. {style} Shapes: about 30% fewer curves than a usual cute drawing: bodies, ears, trees, leaves and mushrooms are built from tall, straight-sided shapes, rectangles, triangles and straight lines with only slightly rounded corners; few swirls, few wiggly lines, no curly decorations. Composition: fill the entire canvas edge to edge and side to side with a dense gathering of these characters, standing and overlapping at many heights, peeking over and between each other, with dense, detailed foliage (ferns, leaves, odd plants, mushrooms, flowers) woven into every gap. Shapes at the edges are cut off; no margin, no border, no empty background. Give enough clear, separate sections for hours of colouring together. Style rules: zero shading and zero colour: no grey, no gradients, no solid black fills, no colour of any kind. Every surface is a pure white interior with a clean black outline. Use one continuous, clean, consistent black ink outline throughout, like a premium uncoloured comic book panel printed on smooth white paper; textures (fur, feathers, leaves) are drawn only as fine lines. Friendly and funny, not scary. No text anywhere: no letters, no words, no numbers, no sound words (like HIC or BOOM), no writing on signs, shirts, books or boxes (signs and shirts are blank), no logo, no signature, no watermark. This is the flat artwork file itself, seen straight on: not a photo of paper.
guide_prompt: The attached image is a colouring poster. Paint about one in seven of its characters and objects (about 15% of the picture), scattered evenly over the whole sheet and never two side by side, with hand-painted gouache and crayon texture: visible dry-brush strokes, a little grain and uneven colour, soft rosy cheeks, in this palette: {palette}. Paint the whole object, all of its parts, right up to its black outlines. Leave all the other characters and objects pure white. Keep every black line exactly as it is, in the same place. Do not add, move or remove anything. Same size and framing as the attached image. No text. This is the flat artwork file itself, seen straight on: not a photo of paper.
colour_prompt: The attached image is a colouring poster with some shapes already painted. Paint every white shape so the whole picture is finished, in exactly the same hand-painted way as the shapes that are already painted: gouache and crayon texture, visible dry-brush strokes, a little grain and uneven colour, rosy cheeks, scratch marks for fur, in this palette: a warm painterly palette: pumpkin orange, mustard yellow, tomato red, soft black, cornflower blue, dusty rose, sage green and cream. Fill the white background spaces between the shapes with a soft painted cream paper tone. Keep every black line, every shape and every already painted shape exactly as they are, in the same places. Do not add, move or remove anything. Same size and framing as the attached image. No text, no letters, no signature. This is the flat artwork file itself, seen straight on: not a photo of paper.

progress.scene: Photorealistic top-down photograph looking straight down at the attached colouring poster: a large landscape paper sheet, 100 x 70 cm, unrolled flat on a light oak floor in a bright living room, its corners held down by a few books with plain covers. A parent and a young child kneel side by side at the bottom long edge and colour it together: only their hands, forearms and knees are visible at the bottom of the photo, no faces and no heads. The child holds a chunky crayon, the parent a coloured pencil. Coloured pencils and crayons lie around on the paper and the floor. Two or three shapes near their hands are freshly coloured in by hand; everything else on the sheet is exactly as in the attached image. The sheet is much bigger than the hands, at a realistic scale, and fills most of the photo. Soft daylight, square photo.

wall.scene: Photorealistic interior photograph of the attached finished colouring poster in a thin light oak frame, hanging on a warm white wall above a low oak sideboard in a calm Scandinavian family living room, with a green plant and two books with plain covers on the sideboard. The framed picture is large, 100 x 70 cm, landscape, about as wide as the sideboard. Soft daylight from a window, square photo.

photo_tail: Show the picture on the paper exactly as it is in the attached image, with the same drawing, colours and proportions, nothing added and nothing removed. Photorealistic, natural colours. No readable words or letters anywhere in the photo, also not on books or boxes. No logo.
